story_review.one_viewing_summary: Intended chain on the measured clock, from code and the third silent phone film. A tower camera's display pans dry land from the first frame and pulls back to the tower. 16 of 56 cameras light through sixteen. Smoke appears in the display and the flag box locks on it on smoke. The alert card leaves the display for the crew truck as the software sends is heard and lands on the dash phone at the AEP Texas team. The dash clock marks an estimated window of up to ten minutes. The plume keeps burning and the cameras don't stop fires. Wide, a dashed line from the truck's landed alert stops short of a responder badge as can share is heard. The utility's wildfire lead reports no major fire since launch over the visor calendar. The record stays blank. The plan waits on state approval.
story_review.opening_to_ending: Opens on what the camera sees and ends on the alert landed with the crew, the line to responders open and the plan awaiting approval, with every picture on its measured words.
